$comment: Per-role model ladder and effort level. ADR-0018 (ladder), ADR-0021
(effort), ADR-0059 (rungs are family aliases). One object per role so
the two never drift apart: two maps keyed by role would be a
synchronization debt, and this file exists to be a single source.
ladder: family aliases (fable, opus, sonnet, haiku), ordered by
preference. The Claude Code CLI resolves an alias to that family's
newest generation, so a generation launch changes nothing here; a new
family, or a changed judgement about a seat, is the only edit. The
guard runs the first rung not listed in the ledger issue labeled
model-limits, which agent-pause keys by rung. The LAST rung is the
floor: an exhausted ladder skips the cycle rather than silently
dropping to a weaker model. An empty ladder means no --model flag:
action default, never falls back, never skipped for model reasons.
effort: one of low, medium, high, xhigh, max. Always set, never empty:
an empty value takes the model's own default, and that default moved
between generations once already (Opus 5 high, Opus 5.5 medium), a cut
an alias rung would now import silently. An unrecognized value is
ignored with a log line rather than failing the run.
thrift (issue #202): optional per-role ladder/effort override, applied
for one cycle whenever agent-guard projects the allowance-state ledger's
week-average burn to miss the next seven-day reset. No file edit either
direction: the guard re-projects on every wake. A role already on its
floor family has nothing cheaper to fall back to and needs no entry.
The BDFL owns this file (ADR-0031). It lives outside .github/ so an edit
is an ordinary app-token commit. Each seat's $comment carries its current
reason; the history is agents/SOURCES.md's adoption log.

bdfl.$comment: Thrift suspended (#897): speed up the director, slow down the rest, until the agent-system backlog (#486 et al.) is down. The allowance projection is one shared reading, so a heavier bdfl burn tightens the discretionary keep_fraction (ADR-0039) for the other seats on the next agent-audit cycle, no cadence hand-pulled. Restore a thrift block once the queue is clear; a wake under ~20 turns posting nothing would restore it sooner.

curator.$comment: Opus first, sonnet floor: adversarial critique is this seat's whole output, and weak sparring trains authors to ignore it (ADR-0044). One daily wake; thrift sheds the opus delta first.

herald.$comment: Opus floor, no sonnet rung: writing quality for humans is this seat's whole output (ADR-0040); thrift trades it only against a dead factory. Effort medium is what Opus 5.5's default handed this seat unpinned since 2026-09-27, kept as a stated choice under 'cost effective for the others' (operator, Telegram, 2026-10-03); raise to high when the retrospect reads the prose as thin.

reviewer.$comment: Sonnet held deliberately: highest session count in the fleet and the cheapest seat per run (22.9% of fleet cost at a $0.71 median, run-telemetry 2026-09-19). The opus raise is pricable and is not taken while the governor reads SLOW DOWN.
